announcements.headline: Half-year Financial Report
announcements.insight: As a VCT, FTV's half-year results are critical for assessing net asset value stability and dividend sustainability in a high-interest-rate environment; any deviation from consensus impacts income-focused investor sentiment directly.

announcements.headline: Intention to Fundraise
announcements.insight: This capital raise is critical for Foresight VCT to maintain its investment pipeline in a constrained market where new deal flow has slowed significantly. The move signals an intent to preserve liquidity and support existing portfolio companies rather than aggressive expansion, reflecting the broader challenges facing the VCT sector.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: Routine director dealing announcements are standard regulatory disclosures for VCTs and typically carry negligible market impact unless the volume is exceptional or signals a specific insider view on valuation.

announcements.headline: Dividend Declaration
announcements.insight: As a VCT, dividend declarations are the primary mechanism for delivering tax-efficient returns to retail investors, making this a routine but critical operational update rather than a transformative event. The announcement signals continued capital deployment and income generation capability in a challenging alternative investment landscape.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: As a standard administrative outcome for a closed-end investment trust, this RNS confirms routine shareholder approval of resolutions with no material change to the company's strategic direction or capital structure.
